title: The zero set of a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals on an affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals (a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module of $\mathcal O_X$ which is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]). For $x\in X$ regard the stalk $\mathcal K_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] as an ideal of the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ (the map $\mathcal K_x\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ induced by the inclusion is injective, stalks being filtered colimits), and put $V(\mathcal K)=\{x\in X:\mathcal K_x\neq\mathcal O_{X,x}\}$. Let $U\subseteq X$ be an affine open, $A=\mathcal O_X(U)$, and identify $U$ with $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] by the canonical open immersion $\iota_U:\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$ with image $U$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points], the point $x\in U$ corresponding to the prime $\mathfrak p_x\subset A$. Then for $x\in U$: $\mathcal K_x=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ if and only if $\mathcal K(U)\not\subseteq\mathfrak p_x$. That is, $V(\mathcal K)\cap U=V(\mathcal K(U))=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}A:\mathcal K(U)\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$; consequently $V(\mathcal K)$ is a closed subset of $X$, and it is the underlying set of the closed subscheme of $X$ cut out by $\mathcal K$: for every closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal sheaf $\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is $\mathcal K$ (one exists [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-closed-subscheme]), $i(Z)=V(\mathcal K)$.

proof.text: Suppose the stalk inclusion at x is surjective. Lift the germ of the global section 1, and represent its lift by a section a on U. By TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq_of_isBasis for X.isBasis_affineOpens, shrink the equality of the two germs to an affine W containing x. Naturality makes the restricted a map to 1. IdealSheafData.range_toModulesι_app therefore gives 1 in K.ideal W. If x belonged to K.support, mem_support_iff_of_mem would put x in X.zeroLocus(K.ideal W), contradicting x in X.basicOpen(1)=W. Thus x is outside the support.

proof.text: Conversely let x be outside K.support, and represent any element of the structure-module stalk by b on V. Since K.support is closed and affine opens form a basis, choose affine W containing x inside V minus K.support. By lemma-nagata-ideal-unit-off-support, K.ideal W is the unit ideal. The section b restricted to W is in the range of K.toModulesι.app W by range_toModulesι_app. Choose a preimage section, whose germ maps to the original germ by stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply and germ_res_apply. This proves surjectivity. The chosen lift is only used inside a proof, not to define any data.

lean.statement: theorem quasi_coherent_ideal_zero_set_affine (X : Scheme.{u}) (K : X.IdealSheafData) : (∀ x : X, Function.Injective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map K.toModulesι).hom) ∧ (∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (x : U.1), Function.Surjective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x.1).map K.toModulesι).hom ↔ ¬ K.ideal U ≤ (U.2.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal) ∧ (∀ U : X.affineOpens, {x : X | ¬ Function.Surjective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map K.toModulesι).hom} ∩ U.1 = U.2.fromSpec '' {p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U.1) | K.ideal U ≤ p.asIdeal}) ∧ IsClosed {x : X | ¬ Function.Surjective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map K.toModulesι).hom} ∧ (∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i], i.ker = K → Set.range i = {x : X | ¬ Function.Surjective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map K.toModulesι).hom})
